definitions.explanation: A company that provides insurance products including life insurance, health insurance, auto insurance, and property insurance.

examples.japanese: {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}に{連絡|れんらく}する。
{事故|じこ}の{後|あと}、{保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}に{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: After the accident, I filed a report with the insurance company.

examples.japanese: {複数|ふくすう}の{保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}の{見積|みつ}もりを{比|くら}べてから{決|き}めた。
examples.english: I compared quotes from several insurance companies before deciding.

notes:
A compound of {保険|ほけん} (insurance) and {会社|がいしゃ} (company). Insurance is a significant industry in Japan, and dealings with insurance companies are a common part of adult life — from car accidents and health matters to life insurance and home insurance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to sign up with an insurance company
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}に{請求|せいきゅう}する: to file a claim with an insurance company
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}に{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to inquire with an insurance company
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}の{担当者|たんとうしゃ}: insurance company representative

TYPES OF INSURANCE:
- {生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}: life insurance
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}: auto insurance
- {火災|かさい}{保険|ほけん}: fire insurance
- {医療|いりょう}{保険|ほけん}: medical insurance
- {損害|そんがい}{保険|ほけん}: property/casualty insurance
